text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the parking prohibition on the west side of Hobson Avenue, between Sunrise Avenue and Collip Place. The parking prohibition was implemented a number of years ago to discourage employees from a Bell Canada facility from parking on-street. This facility is now closed and the prohibition is no longer required. Rescinding the parking prohibition is feasible and will result in parking being allowed for up to three hours on the west side of the street. The existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of the Hobson Avenue will remain.
North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Hobson Avenue, between Sunrise Avenue and a point 224 metres north.
